description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment called CameraPreviewFragment that displays a camera preview. It manages camera lifecycle, checks camera availability, and integrates a custom CameraPreview view into its layout, mainly to demonstrate runtime camera permission handling.

classes.name: CameraPreviewFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a camera preview, handling camera lifecycle and permission checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CameraPreviewFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes camera and preview, and handles unavailable camera scenarios.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the camera when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: getCameraInstance
methods.description: Safely attempts to open the specified camera by ID, returning the Camera object or null if unavailable.

methods.name: releaseCamera
methods.description: Releases the camera resource if it is currently in use.
